what_the_user_feels: the key number arrives instead of appearing
compose_hint: animateIntAsState or Animatable on the value, 600-900ms, decelerate; skip when reduce-motion is on
views_hint: ValueAnimator.ofInt with a DecelerateInterpolator; set text on each update with tabular figures

what_the_user_feels: the list settles in, top to bottom
compose_hint: animateItem() on LazyColumn items plus a per-index delay capped at 6 items
views_hint: LayoutAnimationController with a short delay, or ItemAnimator with start delay on first bind

what_the_user_feels: a tile becomes its detail screen
compose_hint: SharedTransitionLayout with sharedElement/sharedBounds (confirm your Compose version supports it)

what_the_user_feels: the title shrinks as you scroll, the screen feels tall
views_hint: CollapsingToolbarLayout with MaterialToolbar or Material 3 large app bar styles

compose_hint: opt in to predictive back; use PredictiveBackHandler or Navigation's built-in transitions
views_hint: enableOnBackInvokedCallback in the manifest and AndroidX back callbacks

what_the_user_feels: completing an action has a tiny physical tick
compose_hint: LocalHapticFeedback.current.performHapticFeedback with a confirm-style type, only on completion
views_hint: View.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.CONFIRM) on supported API levels, with a fallback

what_the_user_feels: progress fills with weight, then settles
compose_hint: Canvas arc driven by Animatable, 700ms, FastOutSlowIn
views_hint: custom View or MaterialProgressIndicator with animated setProgress(value, true)

what_the_user_feels: an empty screen has a point of view
compose_hint: a small vector illustration plus one sentence and one action; no spinner
views_hint: VectorDrawable in an include layout with one MaterialButton

compose_hint: SwipeToDismissBox with a colored background and icon that scale with progress
views_hint: ItemTouchHelper with a drawn background and icon

what_the_user_feels: launch hands off to the app without a blank flash
compose_hint: core-splashscreen with an animated icon and a short exit animation
views_hint: Theme.SplashScreen plus installSplashScreen() in the launcher activity

what_the_user_feels: the app belongs on the home screen
compose_hint: adaptive icon with a monochrome layer and one static or dynamic shortcut
views_hint: ic_launcher.xml adaptive icon with <monochrome> and res/xml/shortcuts.xml

what_the_user_feels: the app's best number lives on the home screen
compose_hint: Glance app widget showing the hero metric
views_hint: RemoteViews or Glance widget with one tap target
